source_text: In Jewish contexts, some progressive rabbis and scholars reinterpret the biblical covenant (Genesis 17:10-14) as symbolic rather than requiring physical cutting, proposing Brit Shalom as a faithful alternative that honors peace (shalom) over ritual injury, while acknowledging halachic traditions that deem uncircumcised males ineligible for certain communal roles. [34]
